parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The account ID of the owner.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default: 20.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. Call the ListProjects operation to get the workspace ID.

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: The scope of the parameter. The default value is Project. Other values are not supported.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field to sort the parameters by. Specify the value in the "FieldName SortOrder" format. The Asc sort order is optional. Supported values are:

- ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

- Name (Desc/Asc)

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the parameter. Valid values:

- PlainConstant: A plaintext constant.

- SecretConstant: A secret constant.

- Variable: A variable.
